name: BeepBeep AI – Alt Text Generator for Image SEO & WooCommerce
author: Benjamin Graham Oats

sections.description:
WooCommerce bulk alt text generation for product images, variations, and large catalogs to improve image SEO and accessibility in less time.

BeepBeep AI helps store teams fix missing alt text in bulk so product media can rank better in Google Images and product search while staying accessible.

Generate descriptive, context-aware alt text across your WordPress Media Library, review suggestions, and update in one controlled workflow.

Built for WooCommerce Stores

  • Generate bulk alt text for featured product images and gallery photos in one pass.
  • Cover variable products and variation images with consistent, search-friendly descriptions.
  • Scale across large catalogs without writing alt text manually for every SKU.
  • Keep operations fast with an admin-side workflow built for high-volume media updates.
  • Review, edit, and approve AI output before save to maintain full merchandising control.

No credit card required. Start generating alt text immediately.

Demo Video

Why Choose BeepBeep AI

  • Bulk alt text generation for 100+ images in one session
  • WooCommerce product image support
  • Context-aware AI descriptions
  • Edit before publish control
  • Clean, native WordPress dashboard experience
  • Designed to support WCAG accessibility standards

Key Features

Bulk Alt Text Fixer

Scan your Media Library and generate alt text for all missing images in a single workflow.

Auto Generate on Upload

Automatically create alt text whenever a new image is uploaded.

WooCommerce Optimized

Works seamlessly with product images, galleries, and variations.

Review & Regenerate

Edit AI suggestions or regenerate if needed before saving.

Trial Mode

Try up to 10 generations instantly before creating an account.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Navigate to BeepBeep AI → Dashboard.
  3. Scan your Media Library.
  4. Generate alt text in bulk and review suggestions.
sections.faq:
Does this improve SEO?

Search engines rely on descriptive alt text to understand images. This plugin helps generate consistent alt descriptions across your site.

Is this compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. Product images and galleries are fully supported.

Can I review AI suggestions before publishing?

Yes. You remain in control and can edit or regenerate descriptions before saving.

Does it slow down my site?

No frontend scripts are loaded. All functionality runs inside the WordPress admin area only.
